title: 2027 price book rollout plan (DRAFT)
content:
2027 price book rollout plan - DRAFT, not approved

Proposal: move every self-serve account to the 2027 price book for usage from 1 April 2027, so the change lands after Q1 close.

Open questions:
- Batch API discount: keep 50%?
- Do we need 30 days' notice for self-serve? Legal to confirm.
- Should the effective date line up with the billing timezone change instead?

Next step: FP&A decision in January; the final date goes in the close calendar.
